Noah: spotted a small but consistent double-charge pattern in the canary this morning. Looks like retries + truncation + cross-region finalization.
Priya: can you paste a sanitized trace?
Noah: ```
2026-03-24T18:20:12Z req=aa-77 route=us-east-1 client_session=cs-77 toolcall_id=tc-77 provisional=1200 truncated_at=1190
2026-03-24T18:20:15Z retry routed-> eu-west-1 req=aa-77 client_session=cs-77 toolcall_id=tc-77 provisional=1200
2026-03-24T18:20:20Z ledger: both branches confirmed -> billed 2400 tokens
```
Ellen: Interesting - toolcall_id was present on both attempts, but confirmations happened independently in two regions. This is a commit-window race, not just missing idempotency.
Priya: two remediations: 1) quick: add a commit_conflict metric + reconcile job that finds same toolcall_id confirmed in >1 region within 2m; 2) medium: short global finalizer/lease or small finalization delay so only one region can commit.
Noah: also consider session-affinity for retries to reduce cross-region commits.
Ellen: telemetry: tag provisional with origin_route and finalizer_route in traces, so console can show "provisional origin -> confirmed finalizer" mismatches. Add a console card for commit_conflicts.
Priya: I'll own telemetry + console card. Noah you want to own reconcile job + billing ticket?
Noah: yep. I'll open BLG-2026-XYZ and draft the reconcile query.
opsbot: created BLG-2026-XYZ and pinged @billing (auto)
Ellen: For medium term I'll prototype a 2s delayed-commit behind a flag and a light coordinator lease. We'll measure canary impact.
Priya: add a small canary gauge for "requests_missing_flow_or_toolcall_id_pct" to catch clients that never send idempotency info.
Noah: agreed. Action items listed. I'll drop traces into this thread as I find them.
Priya: thanks — ping when BLG ticket has updates.
Ellen: will follow up with design doc for finalizer.
